verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an official, hosted MCP server that AI assistants (Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Perplexity) connect to in order to query controls, surface failing tests, and remediate them. It runs in each region, and a quickstart covers connecting it and generating remediation plans. A separate developer-docs MCP server is also offered, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page and llms.txt exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
